verdict.rationale: Docs mention "global code search" to locate code snippets and navigate repositories, but there is no evidence of fuzzy matching, advanced filters, or regular-expression search support in GitHub Mobile specifically. Community feedback focuses on navigation bugs and UI issues rather than confirming advanced search capabilities. missing for 10: evidence of fuzzy matching, filter operators, regex search syntax, and hands-on confirmation that mobile search matches desktop GitHub's code search feature set.
